text:
priya: flagging a partner incident: they observed duplicate side-effects when a 429 arrived right as our client was refreshing credentials. Customer hit twice and was billed twice. :(

priya: minimal log excerpt (sanitized):
```
2025-01-09T16:22:10Z INFO req id=op999 status=429 retry-after=0.25
2025-01-09T16:22:10Z INFO auth refresh start session=acct_XXX
2025-01-09T16:22:10Z INFO internal immediate retry -> 200 (side-effect applied)
2025-01-09T16:22:11Z INFO auth refresh done; drain queued -> 200 (side-effect applied)
```

tom: yep, classic replay race. We currently allow an immediate retry path + a queued drain path. Need to make safe-by-default.

elena: new mitigation proposals (ranked):
1) enqueue mutating requests during in-flight refreshes by default (send only after refresh completes)
2) client-side lightweight dedupe: keep a short-lived in-memory fingerprint cache (keyed by method+path+body hash) to avoid re-sending if identical op already succeeded in last 5s
3) automatic Idempotency-Key header for sampleapps and onboarding templates (opt-out flag)

ben: I like 2) as defense-in-depth. If servers don't support idempotency, client dedupe reduces duplicates. Implementation note: store fingerprint -> status (pending/succeeded) with TTL ~10s. On success mark succeeded; ignore subsequent identical attempts until TTL expires.

priya: important: always honor Retry-After when present. If Retry-After > 0.9s defer to that instead of local backoff. For small Retry-After or missing header, use jittered exponential backoff:
```
base = 100ms
delay = base * (2 ** attempt) * (0.6 + rand()*0.8)  // broad jitter
cap = 3s
```

tom: parity item: Node currently enqueues; Py currently does immediate retry in some code paths. We should align to enqueue-by-default across SDKs and expose a config toggle `client.config.replay_strategy = "enqueue" | "immediate"` (default "enqueue").

elena: streaming requests: we can't always pause. For streaming/multipart uploads, use fingerprinting + server-side idempotency recommended. Document that streaming may need explicit Idempotency-Key and server dedupe. Flag streaming as follow-up work.

ben: tests: add deterministic integration test that simulates: 429 -> start refresh -> immediate retry accepted by server -> queued drain also accepted. Expected final state: single applied side-effect when client-side dedupe or idempotency enabled. We'll mock time and record request fingerprints.

priya: telemetry & alerts: emit metric sdk.replay.auth_refresh.count and sdk.dedupe.hits.count. Add alert when replay.auth_refresh.count spikes > X% of normal traffic for 5m. Also emit tag sdk=js|py.

tom: rollout plan: patch Node + sampleapp this sprint (3 days for PR + 2 days QA). Py parity next sprint. Add docs + KB entry for support to explain idempotency recommendations.

elena: sampleapp change: set header 'Idempotency-Key' by default for POST/PUT/DELETE in examples, plus a README note explaining why. Also add `client.config.auto_idempotency=true` in quickstart templates.

ben: impl details: fingerprint cache should be bounded LRU (max 5000 entries) and thread-safe. Use MurmurHash of body+path+headers that vary. Make TTL configurable via `client.config.dedupe_ttl_ms` default 10000.

priya: assignment: tom -> Node enqueue + telemetry, ben -> fingerprint cache impl and tests, elena -> sampleapp + docs, I'll own customer comms and KB. Support-bot: notify ops when patch is released.

support-bot: created incident note INC-2025-01-09-dup-billing, assigned to priya.

elena: follow-up: open RFC for streaming strategy. Also add code comments in both SDKs on rationale so future contributors don't revert behavior.

tom: one more thought: when draining queued reqs after refresh, check dedupe cache before sending. If cache indicates success already, skip send and emit metric sdk.replay.skipped_due_to_dedupe.

priya: timeline: aim for hotfix release for Node+sampleapp within 7 business days. Py follow-up within 14. We'll include telemetry so we can validate in prod.

ben: noted. I'll add unit tests for cache eviction and concurrency.

priya: thanks team. Please post PR links here and tag me. :sparkles:
